Q: Why is the exception throwing behavior of "ShowDialog" different if launched with the Visual Studio debugger attached? A:

That's a behavior of 64bit windows: exceptions occurring in the load or shown events of forms get swallowed. A nice explanation can be found at https://web.archive.org/web/20150417222450/http://blog.paulbetts.org/index.php/2010/07/20/the-case-of-the-disappearing-onload-exception-user-mode-callback-exceptions-in-x64/

Q: Expo SDK 55: npx expo install --check says dependencies are up to date, but versions differ from new project template A:

Short answer, you are already doing in the correct way.

Expo only recently changed it so that dependencies follow the Expo SDK versioning. Meaning that before, every version had a different number. Now they all start with 55.x.x since your are using Expo 55. If you update to Expo 56 in the future, this will be 56.x.x for example.

If we take a look at @react-navigation/bottom-tabs, the most recent version is 7.15.9 which is not far of from what you have (7.7.3). This package is not managed by Expo so you will have to regularly look & update yourself if you want to constantly update it.

Q: How to use MAP() , BYCOL() or BYROW() to return multiple arrays? A:

Rather than using map, try Makearray or Reduce

=LET(data,B2:E5,size,COLUMNS(data),MAKEARRAY(size,size,LAMBDA(r,c,RANK(INDEX(data,r,c),INDEX(data,0,c),1))))

or

=LET(data,B2:E5,DROP(REDUCE("",SEQUENCE(COLUMNS(data)),LAMBDA(a,c,HSTACK(a,RANK(INDEX(B2:E5,0,c),INDEX(B2:E5,0,c),1)))),,1))
